newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end lower on end-quarter adjustment.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end lower on end-quarter adjustment.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed slightly lower on Monday in heavy trade as investors adjusted portfolios at the end of the quarter, dealers said.
The general index shed 0.63 points, 0.13 percent, to 466.96 while the Ibex fell 8.40 points, 0.16 percent, to 5,349.30.
Santander was heavily traded, bolstered by put-throughs. The bank shed 150 pesetas to 9,570 amid investor position-adjusting, dealers said.
Other stocks were mixed, with Telefonica up 5 pesetas to 3,380. Repsol was flat at 5,800 after announcing a final dividend of 102 pesetas gross.
With little in the way of market-moving news, dealers described trade as dull, with many market participants already on holiday during this Easter week.
In any case, the bourse is limited by the prospect of Tuesday's Federal Reserve policy-setting meeting, at which some are expecting a hike in short term U.S. interest rates, dealers said.
The Bank of Spain is due to auction repos on Tuesday, but no change in its 5.75 percent key money market rate is anticipated.
